questions.stem: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, "She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son." How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: The man's grandfather's only son is the man's own father. The daughter of the man's father is the man's sister.

questions.stem: If A is the brother of B, and B is the sister of C, and C is the father of D, how is D related to A?
questions.explanation: A, B, and C are siblings. C is the father of D, which makes A the uncle of D. Therefore, D is the nephew or niece of A (since D's gender is unspecified).

questions.stem: Pointing to a lady, a man said, "The son of her only brother is the brother of my wife." How is the lady related to the man?
questions.explanation: The 'brother of my wife' is the man's brother-in-law. The lady's brother is the father of this brother-in-law, which means the lady's brother is the father of the man's wife (his father-in-law). Thus, the lady is the sister of his father-in-law.

questions.stem: A is the uncle of B, who is the daughter of C. C is the daughter-in-law of P. How is A related to P?
questions.explanation: B is the daughter of C. Since A is the uncle of B, A must be the brother of C's husband. C is the daughter-in-law of P, which means C's husband is the son of P. Since A is the brother of C's husband, A is also the son of P.

questions.stem: Pointing to a boy, Meena said, "He is the son of my grandfather's only child." How is the boy related to Meena?
questions.explanation: Meena's grandfather's only child would be Meena's parent (either father or mother). The son of her parent is her own brother.

questions.stem: In a family of six persons A, B, C, D, E and F, there are exactly two married couples. D is the grandmother of A and mother of B. C is the wife of B and mother of F. F is the granddaughter of E. What is the relation between C and A?
questions.explanation: C is the wife of B, making them a couple. D is the mother of B. Since D is the grandmother of A, and C and B are the parents (C is mother of F), B and C must be the parents of both A and F. Therefore, C is the mother of A. E must be D's husband (the grandfather).

questions.stem: If P + Q means P is the husband of Q; P / Q means P is the sister of Q; and P * Q means P is the son of Q. How is D related to A in the exact expression A * B + C / D?
questions.explanation: A * B: A is the son of B. B + C: B is the husband of C (so C is A's mother). C / D: C is the sister of D. Thus, D is the brother or sister of A's mother. Since D's exact gender is unknown, D is the maternal uncle or maternal aunt of A.
